name: Healthcare CFO — Budget Variance & Comp Controls
narrative:
Dana Reyes is the CFO of a regional health system, and it's the Friday before the board meeting. The full-year expense forecast is tracking about $4.8M over budget while revenue is basically flat — so the board's question writes itself: is this a demand problem or a cost problem? Dana needs a board-ready answer, not a data project.

The dashboard drills from the headline miss down to one department (Nursing) and one line — contract labor, where RN vacancies are backfilled with agency nurses at ~2x cost through a single vendor. Ask Genie "why is Nursing over budget?" and it says the same in a sentence. Governance masks the comp detail: Finance sees it, Operations sees headcount only.
